items.computation: This is a private-law invoice, so §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB apply directly (no authority deemed-delivery rule). The period runs 'nach dem Rechnungsdatum' (after the invoice date), so the invoice date itself (07.09.2026, a Monday) is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB); counting starts 08.09.2026. Adding 14 days lands on 21.09.2026 (a Monday), which is a normal working day in NRW (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 193 BGB). Final due date: 21.09.2026.

warnings: This invoice's payment deadline (21.09.2026) has already passed as of today (26.09.2026); the person should check whether payment was made or whether a reminder/dunning has since arrived.
